14.label: The Death of Grete
14.desc: Grete from the floor below has not been seen in four days. Her door is locked and her cat is on your sill. Nobody has asked the Watch, because nobody asks the Watch. (The Warrens)

16.label: The Wrong Door
16.desc: a candle burned down in a locked room. They went somewhere they were not supposed to be.

17.label: An Unfinished Letter
17.desc: "I cannot keep pretending, and I will not let you—" It stops there.

18.label: Apollonia Schmidt
18.desc: Apollonia Schmidt, her brother from the Warrens. Has a fresh linen binding wrapped around one hand. (Accused in: The Death of Grete)

item.label: A ferry token to the coast
item.text: Found with their things. It means something to somebody.

result.label: Traced: a ferry token to the coast
result.text: It leads to a name, and the name leads to a reason.

21.label: A ferry token to the coast
21.desc: Found with their things. It means something to somebody. Take it to Study. (Raw proof in: The Death of Grete)

22.label: Ottilie de Groot
22.desc: Ottilie de Groot, the man on the floor below. Seals letters with a cracked signet: a bird with half a wing. (Accused in: The Death of Grete)

23.label: A Chewed Clove
23.desc: A clove, chewed flat and spat behind the stove. Somebody with a bad tooth stood here a while.

24.label: Stoffel Tucher
24.desc: Stoffel Tucher, the landlord's son. Chews cloves against the toothache, constantly. (Accused in: The Death of Grete)

25.label: The Sergeant's Questions
25.desc: The Watch pulls Grete out of the river. A sergeant is on your stair by noon, wanting to know why you were asking at her door. Reason with him: put this in Question with Wit.

journal.title: The Watch Has a Body
journal.text: The Watch pulls Grete out of the river. A sergeant is on your stair by noon, wanting to know why you were asking at her door.

journal.title: Back at the Scene
journal.text: You go back over the Last Known Door. You find: A Chewed Clove. A neighbour, leaning on the gate, offers a name: Stoffel Tucher.

journal.title: Back at the Scene
journal.text: You go back over the Last Known Door. You find: A ferry token to the coast. A neighbour, leaning on the gate, offers a name: Ottilie de Groot.

journal.title: The Day-book
journal.text: A woman reports her husband missing. He is at the Red Ox. You find him in ten minutes.

journal.title: At the Scene
journal.text: You go in past the beadle at the Last Known Door. You find: The Wrong Door, An Unfinished Letter. The first name in the casebook: Apollonia Schmidt.

journal.title: A Day's Labour
journal.text: A Coin, honestly earned, and your back knows it.

journal.title: A Notice: The Vanishing of Grete
journal.text: Grete from the floor below has not been seen in four days. Her door is locked and her cat is on your sill. Nobody has asked the Watch, because nobody asks the Watch. Nobody else is going to look.

journal.title: The Day-book
journal.text: Forty people come to the desk. Thirty-nine of them are nothing.

journal.title: A Day's Labour
journal.text: A Coin, honestly earned, and your back knows it.

journal.title: Before the Office
journal.text: No office, no stipend, no name the crier would sing. You lodge at a rented room on the Market, and you live by whatever work the Market has. Health in Attend earns a Coin; so does Wit, more slowly. The city has not noticed you yet.

spec.label: Letter: Beadle
spec.desc: A parish beadle with a staff and a loud voice. Knocks on doors without complaining and whips beggars without being asked. Costs 1 Coin.

intro.hint: The Watch wants a word, and the sergeant has already sat you down. Your Wit is doing the talking; wait for him to be satisfied.
